comparison.objective: Seat a filled syringe in a pump and bring its plunger driver into contact without displacing the plunger; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Syringe task tests precise flange-slot insertion, axial seating, and cautious slider contact. Candidate tests tool insertion into a setscrew, bimanual unlocking, fine rotary adjustment, relocking, and repeated physical-cycle assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Syringe must be aligned and seated within millimetric/angular tolerances, with the driver flush and plunger motion limited to 1 mm. Candidate must stop a ≥0.85 J carriage safely in two consecutive cycles and retain its collar setting after locking.
comparison.reason: Precision alignment and no-dose contact do not test iterative damper tuning or fastener-secured adjustment; the shared need for careful contact is generic.
